summary.headline: Acutaas Q1 FY27 revenue rose 59.1% YoY to INR329.7 crore, with EBITDA margin at 34.3% and PAT up 70.4% to INR74.9 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was INR329.7 crore, up 59.1% YoY, driven by Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediates (CDMO and core pharma intermediates) growing 76.5%. Gross margin expanded 466 bps to 57.9% and EBITDA margin expanded 973 bps to 34.3%, with PAT of INR74.9 crore (22.7% margin). Specialty Chemicals revenue fell 10.6% YoY to INR37 crore as commodity products are phased out. Management reiterated 25% FY27 revenue growth and FY26-like margins, and battery chemicals plant has started commercial supply with ramp-up expected over coming quarters.

financial_highlights.change: down from ~INR11 crore in Q4 FY26 (lower euro FX gain: INR10 lakh vs INR10 crore)

segments.name: Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediates
segments.commentary: Revenue INR292.7 crore, up 76.5% YoY; CDMO grew strongly and core pharma intermediates grew robustly on top products and new products gaining volume. Pharma margin around 36%.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.commentary: Revenue INR37 crore, down 10.6% YoY as commodity chemicals are phased out; BFC business recovered strongly but was offset. Spec Chem margin around 24%.

demand_pricing: Battery chemicals demand described as unprecedented on tight global supply; constrained by plant capacity, not demand. Multiple customers across North America, Korea and other regions.
Management attributes CPU and memory chip demand growth to AI and sees BFC photoresist-type materials demand growing.
Healthy RFP activity across CDMO and NCE products; company adds 30-40 molecules a year to its pipeline.
Apixaban demand picking up with sufficient capacity; Caplyta-related generic product qualified with a partner, DMF filed, awaiting launch.
Indichem margin guided to be benchmarked to BFC/specialty margins rather than API; too early to quantify. Gulf geopolitical tensions affected raw material supply, managed through sourcing.

qa_highlights.question: Were battery chemical revenues recognised in Q1, and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Validation of the new plant completed and supply has started; management would not quantify Q1 revenue or FY27 battery revenue but expects quarter-on-quarter ramp-up with supply contracts in place.

qa_highlights.question: Indichem Korea plant timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Construction ahead of schedule, capex expected complete by end of Q1 FY27; revenue expected from FY28. No commercial timeline committed for new products.

qa_highlights.question: Employee cost outlook for FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO guided around INR150 crore of employee cost for the current year, including annual increments and one-time performance bonus.

qa_highlights.question: FY27 capex breakup?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR50 crore pilot plant, INR40-45 crore maintenance, plus spillover electrolyte additive capex; R&D centre and land capex yet to be announced.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company move into electrolyte salts or APIs?
qa_highlights.answer: No plans for electrolyte solution or LiPF6; stays in electrolyte additives. No move upstream into APIs, to avoid competing with customers.

qa_highlights.question: Concentration risk in CDMO?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue concentration rose due to fast ramp of one anchor product; management expects dilution as new CDMO products are added.

risks_watch: Gulf geopolitical tensions and raw material availability.
Transition gap in Specialty Chemicals as commodity products are phased out and new products are commissioned.
Customer and molecule concentration in CDMO, with one anchor product driving growth.
Battery chemicals and Indichem ramp-up timelines not quantified; Indichem margins not yet indicated.
Working capital days rose to 99 from 91 in Q4 FY26 due to higher inventory days.
Other income normalised sharply after Q4 FX gain; further volatility possible.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand, growth and margin targets, with reiterated guidance. Evasive on specifics: declined to quantify battery revenue, CDMO split, Indichem margins and five-year margin outlook, citing confidentiality or prematurity.
key_quotes: Demand here is unprecedented, driven by tight global supply and we, therefore, expect a rapid ramp-up over the coming quarters.
I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
It is constrained by our plant capacity.
guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at 25% for the full year, reiterated by CMD Naresh Patel and President Abhishek Patel.

FY27 EBITDA margin guided at a similar level to FY26 full-year margin, even on a higher revenue base; management said this is a product-mix outcome (CDMO growth and battery chemicals at lower margin).

Specialty Chemicals not expected to decline over full FY27 despite commodity phase-out; commodity revenue to keep declining over coming quarters, offset by BFC, battery chemicals and new specialty products.

Battery chemicals: no revenue quantification; quarter-on-quarter ramp-up expected from Q2 FY27 onwards, with supply contracts in place. Full capacity utilisation of 4,000 MT (VC and FEC) targeted within about 3 years.

CDMO: company has guided INR1,000 crore CDMO revenue and says it is confident of beating this target. Four validated CDMO products expected to contribute from H2 FY27, at INR50-100 crore peak revenue each per year.

Indichem (Korea): revenue expected from FY28 onwards; no commercial timeline committed for new products; full utilisation in 3-4 years. Margin guidance withheld as premature, to be benchmarked to BFC/specialty margins rather than API.
Revenue mix: Advanced Pharma Intermediates was 87% of FY26 revenue and Spec Chem 13%; management expects Pharma to fall to about 80% within 3 years. Five-year margin outlook not guided.
capex_capacity: Q1 FY27 capex INR56 crore: INR15 crore at Indichem site and INR41 crore at ACL site, mainly battery chemical project at Jhaghadia, plus pilot plant at Sachin and maintenance.

FY27 planned capex: about INR50 crore pilot plant, INR40-45 crore maintenance, plus spillover electrolyte additive capex. R&D centre and land acquisition capex not yet quantified; to be announced when finalised.

Capacity utilisation for the quarter: Sachin 83%, Ankleshwar (Unit 2) 23%, Jhagadia (Unit 3) 55%. Sachin described as at capacity limit; Ankleshwar expected to fill up by about FY28, prompting land search.
Battery chemicals (Jhaghadia): 2,000 MT VC and 2,000 MT FEC capacity, commercial supply started after trial run and validation; demand stated to be constrained by plant capacity.

Electrolyte additives Phase 2 (third product): capex on schedule, to complete by end of Q2 FY27 with trial runs soon after; signed contract in place. Fourth product capex to be announced after long-term supply contract is signed.
Indichem Korea plant: construction ahead of schedule, capex expected complete by end of Q1 FY27; R&D facility already commissioned.

Electrolyte additives Phase 2 (third product) capex, completion by end of Q2 FY27 with trial runs soon after
Indichem Korea plant, capex expected complete by end of Q1 FY27; revenue expected from FY28
Pilot plant at Sachin (~INR50 crore planned FY27 capex)

growth.why: Management reaffirmed 25% FY27 revenue growth with stable margins; backing is partial, citing battery chemicals capacity (4,000 MT, commercial supply started), four CDMO products from H2 FY27 at INR50-100 crore peak each, and Sachin at 83% utilisation, but no quantified battery revenue and Indichem revenue only from FY28.
